s.font: Feature Deck Web Light Italic 300 italic 16px/17.6px ls:normal

out.text: Collaborate with us to deliver an agentic solution that grows CSAT, unlocks new revenue streams and generates business intelligence for your clients.

s.font: Feature Deck Web Light Italic 400 48px/48px ls:-0.96px

out.text: Enhance your service offering with cutting-edge AI technology, providing your clients with the best agentic commerce solution.
Unlock our revenue-sharing model, earning a competitive share and SPIFFs for each new customer you bring to Siena.
Expand your client base by receiving qualified business from our partner ecosystem. Includes co-marketing and networking opportunities.
Enjoy personalized support from a dedicated partner manager and direct communication channels with our team.
Collaborate on co-marketing initiatives, speaking opportunities, sponsorships, and more to boost your agency's visibility and growth.
Gain access to training and certification programs, empowering your team with the knowledge and skills to excel in AI-driven CX.

s.font: Feature Deck Web Light Italic 400 48px/48px ls:-0.96px

out.text: At Horatio, we believe in a human-AI partnership. Siena handles routine inquiries instantly, freeing our team to focus on high-touch interactions. This hybrid model scales our reach, preserves each brand’s voice, and inspires our people to grow in their careers.
See how partners scale with Siena
